Import and clean cohort intervals for a study

getDataForStudy.Rd

Retrieve cohort data from an OMOP CDM or read local cohort intervals, then apply observation bounds, mandatory-state requirements and optional state merging. The analyst defines the target and clinical state cohorts.

Usage

getDataForStudy(
  runSavedStudy = studyEnv$runSavedStudy,
  useCDM = studyEnv$useCDM,
  trajectoryDataObject = studyEnv$trajectoryDataObject,
  cdm = NULL,
  studyEnv = NULL,
  atlasStateCohorts = studyEnv$atlasStateCohorts,
  atlasTargetCohort = studyEnv$atlasTargetCohort,
  stateCohortLabels = studyEnv$stateCohortLabels,
  baseUrl = studyEnv$baseUrl,
  outOfCohortAllowed = studyEnv$outOfCohortAllowed,
  stateCohortMandatory = studyEnv$stateCohortMandatory,
  stateCohortPriorityOrder = studyEnv$stateCohortPriorityOrder,
  mergeStates = studyEnv$mergeStates,
  allowedStatesList = studyEnv$allowedStatesList,
  stateCohortAbsorbing = studyEnv$stateCohortAbsorbing,
  pathToData = studyEnv$pathToData,
  mergedStateOverrides = studyEnv$mergedStateOverrides
)

Arguments

runSavedStudy

Whether to import fresh data using the analysis rules restored by a saved-study configuration.

useCDM

Whether to retrieve cohorts from the CDM. Use FALSE for a local data frame or CSV file.

trajectoryDataObject

Data frame for a local import. An explicitly supplied non-NULL object overrides the configured CSV path. Supply NULL to use the CSV path. Overrides apply to this import only.

cdm

A CDM reference created with CDMConnector.

studyEnv

Study environment returned by cohort2TrajectoryConfiguration.

atlasStateCohorts

ATLAS state cohort IDs, or local definition names without the .json extension when baseUrl is NULL.

atlasTargetCohort

ATLAS target cohort ID, or local definition name without the .json extension when baseUrl is NULL.

stateCohortLabels

Nonblank, non-missing clinical state labels, unique ignoring case. The labels "0", "START", "EXIT" and "OUT OF COHORT" are reserved, also ignoring case.

baseUrl

OHDSI WebAPI base URL for downloading ATLAS definitions. Use NULL to read local JSON definitions.

outOfCohortAllowed

Whether to retain state records beyond the target interval's end. The target start remains the lower boundary.

stateCohortMandatory

States that every included patient must have within the retained observation bounds. NULL or character(0) imposes no requirements. Rerun import to change these requirements before generation.

stateCohortPriorityOrder

State labels ordered from highest to lowest priority, also used to resolve inherited priorities for merged states.

mergeStates

Whether to compose overlapping state intervals into states with structured membership.

allowedStatesList

Named list of allowed destinations by source state. Each source name must be unique, nonempty and non-missing.

stateCohortAbsorbing

Labels of absorbing states, also used to derive absorbing status for merged states.

pathToData

CSV path for a local import. An explicitly supplied non-NULL path overrides the configured data object. Do not explicitly supply both non-NULL local sources.

mergedStateOverrides

List of mergedState() definitions that replace selected inherited properties of merged states.

Value

Invisibly returns NULL after a successful import. Cleaned data are saved in the study's Data directory and studyEnv is updated for generation.

Details

The target cohort defines observation bounds. Clinical state intervals, including history states and finite episodes, must be defined by the analyst before import. State labels are preserved for CDM, data-frame and CSV input. Spaces and punctuation are not replaced to make filenames. Use the same labels in mandatory states, priorities and transition rules. CSV cohort_definition_id values are read as text, preserving leading zeros and the literal label "NA". Empty labels are invalid. All mandatory-state labels are literal, including "No mandatory state".

A nonempty target cohort remains valid when no clinical state records survive cleaning, provided mandatory-state requirements do not exclude its patients. The target intervals still define follow-up. Discrete trajectories use the configured gap rule. Continuous trajectories retain boundaries without inventing clinical states.

An empty eligible cohort is not a successful import. Previous cleaned data, merged-state artifacts and saved settings remain unchanged. An unsuccessful import blocks trajectory generation until a later import succeeds.

Local input

With neither local source explicitly supplied, the configured data object is used when present, otherwise the configured CSV path is used. An explicit non-NULL source overrides the opposite configured source for this call only. Supplying trajectoryDataObject = NULL selects the CSV path. The same rules apply to saved local studies. CDM imports ignore both local source arguments.

Cohort definitions and saved studies

Fresh CDM imports stage definitions and their manifest in a temporary folder. Downloaded definitions and the manifest are published after data retrieval, cleaning and saving succeed. Failed downloads, queries or empty eligible cohorts leave the previous working JSON files unchanged. Existing local definitions and unrelated JSON files are not rewritten.

Successful CDM source overrides are retained for subsequent imports, keeping target and state selectors and the ATLAS URL aligned with clinical labels. Failed attempts retain the previous source settings. Downloaded definitions use 0.json for the target and atlas_<id>.json for states. Repeated state IDs share a file without changing their clinical labels.

Successful import captures the selected definition filenames and contents. After fresh trajectory generation completes, these are saved with the analysis settings in Settings/analysisSettings.rds. Only version 4 snapshots are accepted. The snapshot contains no patient data.

Saved CDM runs write the embedded definitions to a new private folder and use them to query fresh data. They do not read or replace working JSON files or their manifest. A later fresh import cannot change the definitions in an earlier completed snapshot. Saved local runs require fresh local input. Neither saved mode accepts overrides to its restored analysis rules.

getDataForStudy(cdm = cdm, studyEnv = studyEnv)
} # }
